title: Simultaneous extraction of RNA, DNA and protein from canine mast cell tumour and skin biopsies
author: Deborah Biasoli
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sq2edye
materials: Homogenise a ~3mm tissue biopsy in 700µl of Qiazol (Qiagen) by shaking (at 30Hz) with 2 x 7mm stainless steel balls in a TissueLyser LT (Qiagen) for 10 min at room temperature.
Proceed with RNA extraction using the miRNeasy Mini Kit (Qiagen), following the manufacturer’s instructions.
Air-dry the DNA pellet for 10 min.

steps.title: Initial Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the homogenate into aqueous, interphase, and organic phases using chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the homogenate to a 1.5ml tube and add 140µl of chloroform.
Shake vigorously for 15s.
Allow the homogenate to sit at room temperature for 2 - 3 min.
Centrifuge at 12000 x g for 15 min at 4°C.

steps.title: Phase Collection and Storage
steps.instruction: Collect the separated phases for subsequent extractions.

substeps.instruction: Carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase to a 2ml tube for RNA extraction.
Store the interphase and organic phase at 4°C for DNA and protein extraction.

steps.title: DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA from the stored interphase and organic phases.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.21ml of 100% (v/v) ethanol to the interphase and organic phases and mix carefully by inversion.
Incubate at room temperature for 3 min.
Centrifuge at 2000 x g for 2 min at 4°C.

steps.title: Protein Phase Recovery
steps.instruction: Isolate the phenolic/ethanol supernatant for protein extraction.

substeps.instruction: Carefully transfer the phenolic/ethanol supernatant to a new tube and store at 4°C.

steps.title: DNA Pellet Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet using sodium citrate solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.7ml of sodium citrate solution to the DNA pellet.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 min, mixing by inversion every 5 min.
Centrifuge at 2000 x g for 2 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the addition of sodium citrate, incubation, and centrifugation steps twice more.

steps.title: DNA Pellet Storage (Optional)
steps.instruction: Store the DNA pellet if immediate isolation is not required.

substeps.instruction: Store the DNA pellet in 2ml of 75% (v/v) ethanol at 4°C for up to 3 months.

steps.title: DNA Isolation and Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the DNA pellet and neutralize the sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.4 ml of 75% (v/v) ethanol to the DNA pellet.
Incubate at room temperature for 20 min, mixing by inversion every 5 min.
Centrifuge at 2000 x g for 2 min at 4°C, then completely remove and discard the ethanol supernatant.
Resuspend the DNA pellet in 150μl of 8mM NaOH.
Centrifuge at 14000 x g for 10 min at room temperature and transfer the supernatant to a new tube.
Neutralize the DNA sample by adding 18μl of 0.1M HEPES and 1.65μl of 0.1M EDTA.

steps.title: DNA Storage
steps.instruction: Store the purified DNA samples at -20°C until required.

steps.title: Protein Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate proteins from the phenolic/ethanol phase.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.05ml of isopropanol to the phenolic/ethanol phase and mix by inversion for 15 s.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 min.
Centrifuge at 12000 x g for 10 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Protein Pellet Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the protein pellet using guanidine-ethanol solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.4ml of guanidine-ethanol solution to the pellet and incubate at room temperature for 20 min.
Centrifuge at 7500 x g for 5 min at room temperature and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the addition of guanidine-ethanol and centrifugation steps twice more.

steps.title: Protein Pellet Ethanol Wash
steps.instruction: Perform a final ethanol wash on the protein pellet.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.4ml of 100% (v/v) ethanol to the pellet, vortex, and incubate at room temperature for 20 min.
Centrifuge at 7500 x g for 5 min at room temperature and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Protein Solubilization
steps.instruction: Dissolve the protein pellet using urea/β-mercaptoethanol solution inside a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Add 50μl of urea/β-mercaptoethanol solution and break up the pellet by passing it through a syringe needle.
Add an additional 200μl of urea/2-mercaptoethanol solution, pass through the needle if not completely dissolved, and incubate at room temperature for 1 h.

steps.title: Protein Final Recovery
steps.instruction: Heat-treat and centrifuge to recover the final protein supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 95°C for 3 min, then on ice for ~5 min.
Centrifuge at 12000 x g for 10 min at room temperature.
Transfer the protein-containing supernatant to a new tube and store at -20°C until required.
